finding.claim: r6's integration test does not check what fails_when names after apm uninstall. It lets .claude/settings.json, .agents/hooks.json and .agents/mcp_config.json stay without checking that okf-bundle and the Stop wrapper are gone from them (hook_present needs both hooks, so a leftover wrapper alone passes), and it never reads .mcp.json, which lies outside .claude/ and .agents/.

fixes.change: The fake lock lists the rules under kmctl-claude and kmctl-antigravity as real APM does; the real-install test checks that uninstall leaves no okf-bundle in either MCP file and no kmctl hook in .agents/hooks.json; expected messages updated.
